name: probability_delivery
label: Probability Delivery
description: Each cycle delivers on ONE node, picked by a weighted random draw (e.g. 20% / 80% — not a fixed 20-of-100 split, each cycle is independently random). Advance to the next cycle by fixed delay, presence-clear, or BNC IN rising edge.

parameters.label: Node weight (%)
parameters.help: Per-node pick weight. 0 = that node never gets a pellet (stays idle).

parameters.label: Mimic non-delivering nodes
parameters.help: When on, every weight > 0 node that is not feeding still runs a no-feed dispense so the animal cannot use sound or motion to find the pellet. Weight 0 stays idle.

parameters.label: Advance to next trial
parameters.help: fixed_delay = wait a fixed time; presence_clear = wait until the animal is off the pads; bnc = BNC IN rising edge

parameters.label: Presence-clear settle (s)
parameters.help: Used when Advance = presence_clear — presence must stay clear this long before the next trial
